faq_heading: Langley Office Space for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Office space for sale in Langley: office buildings and office strata units listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
In the second quarter of 2026, 4 of the 20 commercial sales in Langley were office properties, against 46 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Township of Langley and City of Langley zones that allow office uses
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: Does this page include office space for lease?
faq.a: No, only property for sale. For lease listings, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How many office properties sold in Langley recently?
faq.a: 4 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 20 commercial sales in Langley (GVR Commercial Edge).
